description: Ministry of Defence - United Nations Security Council Resolution (UNSCR) 1373 - Regulation No. 1 of 2012
categorisation: This gazette content amends the list of designated persons under the United Nations Regulations, which constitutes a legal/regulatory action. It involves modifying subsidiary legislation (the regulations) under the principal United Nations Act, making it a clear example of legal framework and regulatory matters. While it names a government official (General Kamal Gunaratne) as the Competent Authority, this is only in his capacity as the issuer of the legal notice, and the content does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
